'''Blap biscuits''' were a type of [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]]. It was a gooey biscuit served drenched in [[Carbosyrup]].<ref name="swg">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=item|Blap biscuit}}</ref>

{{Food-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Blap biscuits appeared in the video game Star Wars Galaxies, a massively multiplayer online role-playing game developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by LucasArts, prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].
